paper_title: (Almost) Closing the $ν$MSM Sterile Neutrino Dark Matter Window with NuSTAR
coupling_convention: sin^2(2theta) sterile-neutrino active-neutrino mixing angle (dimensionless), exactly as plotted on the y-axis of FIG. 8
notes: This paper presents new observed 95% C.L. (one-sided, delta-chi2=2.71) limits on STERILE NEUTRINO dark matter (mass m_chi vs mixing angle sin^2(2theta)) from NuSTAR 0-bounce photon observations of the Galactic Center, covering ~10-50 keV masses. Sterile neutrino mixing angle is not among the supported coupling types (axion/dark-photon/scalar enums), so coupling_type is null and no data points are extracted. The limit curves appear only in figures (Fig. 7 decay rate Gamma vs mass; Fig. 8 sin^2(2theta) vs mass); no numerical tables are provided. The analysis assumes NFW-family density profiles normalized to a local density of 0.4 GeV/cm^3 (coreNFW default, J_tot ~ 29 GeV cm^-3 kpc sr^-1), but dm_density_assumed is left null since this is an indirect-detection decay search, not a haloscope. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Paper: Perez et al., '(Almost) Closing the nuMSM Sterile Neutrino Dark Matter Window with NuSTAR' (arXiv:1609.00667). Main result is FIG. 8 (page 9): red 'NuSTAR GC (2016)' line giving upper limits on sin^2(2theta) vs sterile-neutrino mass m_chi (5-50 keV). The constrained quantity is the sterile-neutrino mixing angle, which does NOT correspond to any coupling type in the provided taxonomy (not an axion or dark-photon coupling), hence coupling_type=null and reduced extraction_confidence despite the physics being unambiguous. Curve is highly wiggly; sampled densely at features: peak ~1e-10 at ~7 keV (3.5 keV line region), local min ~1e-11 near 9.5 keV, iron-line bump ~2e-11 at 13 keV, steep drop to ~3e-13 at 15-16 keV, smooth wiggly descent to ~2e-14 at 30 keV, bump/spike near 40-42 keV, and minima ~2e-15 near 48 keV. Excluded region is above the red curve (hatched). DM signal normalized to Galactic Center DM halo models, not a single local density value. | Calibration: No calibration needed (spot-check verify/stage2 raw_ratio=1.00 snapped to identity)
